name: Après le considérant D – 4
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: Da. whereas before the adoption of Regulation (EU) 2019/1022, over 80 % of the assessed stocks were overfished in the western Mediterranean and the biomass of some of these stocks was close to the limit reference point with a high probability of collapse;
